alex: quick q — where do we keep the per-pool KPIs / prom labels? I'm trying to pull a baseline for `eu-dedicated-small` (saturation, queue_length, avg_latency) so I can tune alerts.

maria_s: grafana -> Inference / Pools dashboard. here's the canonical link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/inference-pools (you need VPN). panels: `Pool Saturation`, `Queue Length`, `GPU Util`, `Tokens/sec`.

alex: thanks — can you drop the exact prom queries for saturation and queue length? want to build a short dashboard for the incident runbook.

maria_s: sure. saturation (5m avg):
```
avg_over_time(pool_saturation{pool="eu-dedicated-small"}[5m])
```
queue length (per-pool):
```
sum(rate(pool_queue_length{pool="eu-dedicated-small"}[1m])) by (pool)
```
latency (p50/p95 generation):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{pool="eu-dedicated-small"}[5m])) by (le))
```

maria_s: note: `pool_saturation` is a synthetic metric: vgpu_in_use / vgpu_capacity. we historically set page threshold at 0.85 and warning at 0.70 but that was for larger pools. small pools may need lower thresholds.

samir: fwiw, the first signal that usually bites is `queue_length` spike + sustained `gpu_util` near 90%. saturation alone can be noisy during scheduled infra maintenance.

alex: any recommended baseline numbers for eu-dedicated-small? 0.7 warn / 0.9 page feels high for a small pool.

irina: i'd start with warn=0.6 page=0.8 for that pool. also add alert condition for `tokens_per_sec` drop alongside high queue — that catches degraded throughput vs just bursty traffic.

alex: good call. can you paste the combined alert expression?

irina: combined (example):
```
( avg_over_time(pool_saturation{pool="eu-dedicated-small"}[5m]) > 0.8 )
  and
( increase(pool_queue_length{pool="eu-dedicated-small"}[5m]) > 10 )
```

irina: optional: AND tokens_per_sec{pool="eu-dedicated-small"} < 100 to reduce false positives for warmup jobs.

samir: who owns tuning alerts? i can take a pass but will need owner/triage. probably create a small PR against monitoring-alerts repo and run it through monitoring-review.

alex: please do — create a ticket and ping me. add runbook steps: who to escalate to (infra-oncall), how to check `kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=eu-dedicated-small`, and link to grafana panel.

samir: creating ticket now: MON-7891. PR will follow.

alex: also — where do traces for slow requests live? jaeger? x-ray?

maria_s: jaeger for inference runtime traces. jaeger link: https://jaeger.internal/redwood/search?service=inference-runtime. use trace tag `pool=eu-dedicated-small`.

alex: perfect. last q — logs? which cluster/namespace to grep for eviction/errors?

irina: inference-prod logs are in Loki under `cluster="prod"` and `kubernetes_namespace="inference"`. example query:
```
{cluster="prod", kubernetes_namespace="inference", pool="eu-dedicated-small"} |= "OOM" or |= "evict"
```
